question_or_proposition: Does footnote *9 establish that monitoring and reporting requirements first become applicable on the permit effective date—and, if so, whether that commencement applies only to the Whole Effluent Toxicity testing row that cites *9 or to the broader Part I monitoring and reporting requirements—such that any portion of Federal FY2025 before that effective date is outside the scope of those obligations?
required_context: The permit effective date and its relationship to the Federal FY2025 evaluation window (2024-10-01 through 2025-09-30)
Whether footnote *9 is scoped solely to the WET monitoring row that references it or governs commencement of other Part I monitoring and reporting requirements shown on adjacent pages
PART II Whole Effluent Toxicity testing requirements referenced by footnote *9 for additional WET monitoring conditions and frequency reduction option
notes: Footnote *9 states when monitoring and reporting requirements begin and is cross-referenced from the WET table row, but its wording is general. Resolution affects whether monitoring was required during FY2025 sub-periods (Purpose B) and how to classify missing or no-result evidence for intervals before commencement (Purpose C). It does not directly set numeric discharge limits or alter limit values (Purpose A).
